title: Comparative life cycle assessment of lead-free halide perovskite composites/polymer for piezoelectric energy harvesting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4375-4391
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00717H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Iván P. Franco, Monica Morales-Masis, Iván Mora-Seró, Rosario Vidal
This study evaluates environmental impacts of a lead-free halide perovskite/polymer composite versus traditional PZT ceramics, emphasizing the former's sustainability and potential in energy harvesting applications.
